tagline: Timeless, editorial wedding & family photography in Sonoma, Napa & Northern California
defaultSeoDescription: Timeless, editorial wedding and family photography in Sonoma, Napa and Northern California wine country by Courtney Stockton.

heroSubline: Timeless, editorial photography for weddings, engagements and families across Sonoma, Napa and the rest of Northern California wine country.
introText: I'm a wedding and portrait photographer based in Sonoma County, California, and wife to a Sonoma winemaker, so wine country is quite literally home. I photograph in both digital and film, drawn to real moments: the in-between glances, the laughter, the quiet ones. My work is playful yet sophisticated, modern yet timeless.
philosophyText: Some photographs are made: carefully composed portraits in beautiful light. The best ones simply happen, and my job is to notice. I'll guide you when you need it and disappear when you don't, so your gallery holds both: refined portraiture and the honest, unrepeatable moments in between.

heading: Meet Courtney
subheading: Photographer of all things love in Sonoma, Napa & beyond

children.text: After being inspired by my own love story and wedding photography, I studied photography at the Academy of Art and began shooting weddings in 2012. More than a decade later, it still doesn't feel like work.

Home is Sonoma County wine country, where my husband Joey makes chardonnay and second shoots weddings with me when the cellar lets him go. I photograph in both digital and film, because film has a way of slowing everything down and turning real moments into something that feels like memory.
I'm based in wine country and available worldwide, and Seattle holds a special place in my heart, so my travel fee never applies there.

heading: The Experience
introText: Beautiful galleries begin long before the first photograph. Here is what working together looks like, from your first note to the day your gallery arrives.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.description: Share your date, your venue if you have one, and what you're dreaming up. I'll reply personally with availability and everything you need to decide if we're a fit.

steps.title: We plan together
steps.description: From timelines to light, I'll help you shape a day that leaves room for the moments that matter. Before your wedding or session, we'll talk through light, timing and flow so you know exactly what to expect.

steps.title: Your day, gently guided
steps.description: I blend gentle direction with documentary storytelling, guiding when it helps and stepping back when it doesn't, so the day unfolds naturally while still feeling visually intentional.

steps.title: Your gallery arrives
steps.description: A curated online gallery of finished photographs, ready to share, print and keep. Heirloom albums and prints are available for the images you love most.

closingText: Every wedding and session is different, and that's the point. If this sounds like the kind of photography you want, I'd love to hear your plans.

heading: Investment
introText: Wedding collections, elopements, engagement sessions and family sessions, each tailored to the day at hand. Share your plans and I'll send current collections and availability.

offerings.title: Weddings
offerings.description: Full wedding-day coverage in Sonoma, Napa and beyond: timeless, editorial photography of the whole story, from getting ready to the last dance. Inquire for current collections and availability.

offerings.title: Elopements & intimate weddings
offerings.description: For small celebrations and vow exchanges in beautiful places: wine country, the Sonoma coast, or wherever you're headed.

offerings.title: Engagements
offerings.description: A relaxed session in a place that means something to you, and a lovely way to get comfortable in front of the camera before the wedding.

offerings.title: Families & little ones
offerings.description: Honest, warm photographs of your people, at home, in the meadow, or among the vines. Kids welcome exactly as they are.

heading: Let's tell your story
introText: I'd love to hear what you're planning. Tell me a little about your day, or your family, and I'll reply personally.
successMessage: Thank you. Your note is on its way. I'll be in touch soon. I can't wait to hear more.

quote: If there was a photographer fairy, Courtney Stockton would be it… She floats through the venue capturing each detail. She makes you feel beautiful and hides all those not-so-attractive angles. I still obsess over every photo.
Working with Courtney (and her husband, who was our second photographer) was one of the easiest parts of our wedding.
We are obsessed with all the photos and the way that Courtney and Joey captured so many special moments on our day.
